The overview

Istanbul straddles Europe and Asia across the Bosphorus — a city of imperial mosques, grand bazaars and layered Byzantine and Ottoman history.

Top things to do in Istanbul

  • Visit Hagia Sophia and the Blue Mosque
  • Explore Topkapi Palace
  • Haggle in the Grand Bazaar
  • Cruise the Bosphorus
  • Soak in a historic hammam

Best time to visit

The sweet spot for Istanbul is generally Apr–May & Sep–Oct — and the cheapest fares often land just outside peak season.

Is it safe?

Generally safe. Watch your belongings in crowds and tourist areas, and check your government’s current advisory before you go. Visa for US passports: Visa-free, 90 days.

A bit of history

Founded as Byzantium, it became Constantinople, capital of the Roman/Byzantine empire, then the Ottoman capital after 1453 — a crossroads of civilizations for 2,000 years.

Culture & language

Turkish culture bridges East and West — tea gardens, hospitality, a renowned cuisine, and the daily rhythm of the call to prayer.

Language: Turkish · English spoken: Common in tourist areas

How much is a flight to Istanbul?

When is the best time to visit Istanbul?

The best time to fly to Istanbul is generally Apr–May & Sep–Oct. Shoulder-season trips often pair good weather with lower fares.

Is Istanbul safe for tourists?

Generally safe. As anywhere, watch your belongings in crowds and check your government's current advisory before you go.

Do US citizens need a visa for Turkey?

Visa for US passports: Visa-free, 90 days. Always confirm the latest entry rules with official sources before booking.
